page.layout: One printed page, left part of the scan: running head centred at top, page number at top left, one column of text with a diagram of fractions at the foot of the text. Right edge shows the start of a neighbouring column (cut off, not transcribed).; One printed page, main text column in the centre with diagrams and worked examples; a narrow strip of the facing page at the right edge; a faint footer mark at the bottom.

main_text.p: Diuersi nominis partes, maiores cum minoribus non nisi facta confusione, addi possunt, quare eas ad unum redigere nomen necesse est. Vt 3/5 addantur 4/5, totus ex ijs erit 7/5, siue per reductionem 1 2/5. Item 3/4 addantur 5/8. Hic si quartas cū octauis cofunderes, totus à neutris denominari posset: quare cognomines primùm partes sa-siendæ, tumq; addendæ erunt. Exemplum sic est:
Similiter ½ ad 5/6 & 3/1 addendo, prodeúnt, 106/66 siue per reductionem, 1 20/33. Exemplum sic est:
Subductio numeratio est, quæ cognominum partium numeris à se inuicem subductis, cōmune datarum nomen pro Residui nomine usurpat.

page.notes: Right-hand column and its fragments are cut off in this part and not transcribed. The fraction diagram at the foot is set as stacked numerals; its layout is approximate. Some words in the main line are doubtful due to the scan, e.g. "cognomines" and "cofunderes". The worked fractions and columns are reconstructed from a small, faint diagram; exact placement of the fraction values is uncertain. Facing-page fragments at the right edge are not transcribed.
